description: This file defines the interface for handling mail mapping in a version control system, including functions for reading mailmap data from files or blobs, clearing the mailmap, and mapping user information.

methods.name: read_mailmap_file
methods.description: Reads the mailmap data from a file given a filename and flags.

methods.name: read_mailmap_blob
methods.description: Reads the mailmap data from a blob given a name.

methods.name: read_mailmap
methods.description: Reads the mailmap data from the default source.

methods.name: map_user
methods.description: Maps user email and name to standardized form using the mailmap.
